actions.action: Delete expired records and report source failures explicitly
actions.mechanism: Hard expiry prevents old records from appearing fresh; source failure never extends retention.
actions.implementation: Assign a monotonic expiry no later than 300 seconds after fetch starts. Delete on expiry and before reads. On refresh timeout, return 503 with source_timeout.
actions.check: With a fake clock and stalled source, verify expiration deletes the record, returns no cached payload, and produces 503.
actions.risk: Strict expiration sacrifices availability during outages.

actions.mechanism: Atomic admission couples a public-field allowlist with deterministic least-recently-used eviction.
actions.implementation: Fetch only approved public endpoints and fields. Under one cache lock, purge expired entries, then evict the least-recently-used record before inserting at capacity.
actions.check: Insert 101 distinct records concurrently; assert occupancy never exceeds 100 and the expected victim disappears. Verify forbidden fields never enter cache or logs.
actions.risk: An incorrect allowlist can admit sensitive fields.

actions.action: Merge duplicate fetches and bound source work
actions.mechanism: One in-flight fetch per key prevents duplicate refreshes; deadlines bound waiting during source stalls.
actions.implementation: Share each key's fetch promise. Set a two-second source deadline and a global concurrency limit; reject excess uncached requests with 503 busy. Remove completed promises.
actions.check: Send simultaneous requests for one missing key; observe one source call. Stall it; verify all waiters finish and its promise is removed.
actions.risk: Shared fetch failures affect every waiting request.

actions.action: Temporarily stop calls to a failing source
actions.mechanism: A circuit breaker makes outage handling explicit without changing freshness or eviction rules.
actions.implementation: After three consecutive source timeouts, open for 30 seconds. Serve only unexpired hits; return 503 source_unavailable for misses. Continue expiry deletion; allow one recovery probe.
actions.check: Force three timeouts; verify misses make no source calls during cooldown, expired entries disappear, and a successful probe closes the breaker.
actions.risk: Cooldown can delay detection of source recovery.
